 Halogen Ventures is now accepting applications for its 2026–2027 In-Semester MBA Fellowship! This in-semester fellowship is for students currently enrolled in an MBA program interested in gaining hands-on experience in venture capital. This fellowship is virtual and will run from October 27, 2026 to April 30, 2027. Throughout this fellowship, MBA students will be an extension of the Halogen team and work on projects such as portfolio company support, prospective deal investment evaluation, industry analysis reports, Halogen Operators Program (HOP), and more. The goal of this fellowship is to provide an opportunity for MBAs interested in venture capital to gain real work experience for an extended period of time throughout the school year. Halogen is proud to share that to date the firm has helped over 100 students gain venture capital experience through its fellowship programs, and past Halogen fellows have gone on to work at firms such as Unshackled Ventures, General Atlantic, FJ Labs, CRV, and Qualcomm Ventures.
 If you are passionate about venture capital and the startup ecosystem, we encourage you to apply!
